resources.string: Three fingers scroll the remote window.
Keep viewing when leaving the app
Hardware keyboard and mouse work on the desktop. Android may reserve Alt+Tab or Meta; use the key menu in that case. Horizontal wheel uses Shift + wheel where supported.
Quality, scale and frame limit are requested settings. Other viewers can raise quality, scale or update rate. The counter measures tile updates, not full frames.
Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Esc releases the keyboard and opens session options.
